name: tracer-slices
description: TRACER phase 1, the slice plan: the skeleton first, then slices of 1 to 3 days, one capability each, with their requirements and critical flows and a forecast; read blind against the specs and fixed where confirmed. Writes only docs/tracer/slices.md

steps.title: Plan the slices
steps.prompt:
Write the TRACER slice plan for: {focus}

In docs/tracer/slices.md, as one table with the columns Slice, Capability, Requirements, Flows, Builds on, Days, Status: first the skeleton (one flow end to end on the final architecture, with deployment, CI and the end-to-end runner), then slices of 1 to 3 days, each on exactly one capability of docs/tracer/capabilities.md, listing the requirements and critical flows it covers, what it builds on, and Status `planned`. Below the table, the forecast: the slice count times two days, as a wide range.

steps.title: Read the plan blind
steps.prompt:
Read, without changing any file, the slice plan in docs/tracer/slices.md for: {focus}

Hold it to the method: the skeleton comes first; every slice lands on exactly one capability and fits 1 to 3 days; every MEV requirement and critical flow is in a slice; no slice needs architecture the skeleton does not have; what a slice builds on comes before it. Report each in `findings` with `where` (the row), `what`, `evidence_class`, `cause` and `proof`. Say plainly when there is none.

steps.title: Decide what the reading only read
steps.prompt: Decide, without changing any file, the findings on the TRACER slice plan in docs/tracer/slices.md for: {focus}

steps.title: Fix the confirmed findings
steps.prompt: Fix the confirmed findings below in the TRACER slice plan in docs/tracer/slices.md for: {focus}. Change only docs/tracer/slices.md.

steps.title: Check each fix
steps.prompt: Check, without changing any file, the fix just made in the TRACER slice plan in docs/tracer/slices.md for: {focus}
